repo.description: Repo-wide rules. ROOT test_impact.yaml only; repo-relative globs.

runtime_tests.description: Files that tests read from disk at runtime (not imports). A match selects the listed tests in ADDITION to package rules and even when the path is also safe. run_all still wins.

paths.description: Repo-relative globs of the files read.

except.description: Repo-relative globs excluded from paths, e.g. generated files the tests skip.

tests.description: Repo-relative test files. A missing one fails validate (rule g) and runs its package fully.

tooling.description: Tool settings. ROOT test_impact.yaml only (a tooling block in any other mapping is a config error). Every key is optional.

flutter_command.description: Command prefix that runs Flutter, e.g. [fvm, flutter]. Default [flutter].

dart_command.description: Command prefix that runs Dart, e.g. [fvm, dart]. Default [dart].

isolation_patterns.description: Dart regexes (the loader rejects ones that do not compile). A test, or a helper it imports, matching one runs as its own entrypoint instead of sharing the bundle isolate. Default: generic process-global hazards (get_it registration without reset, Hive init, Bloc globals, HttpOverrides.global, platform instance overrides).

bundle_policy.description: Optional repo-relative path of the bundle policy JSON.

run_all.description: Package-relative. This package full suite plus all transitive dependents' full suites.

run_package.description: Package-relative. This package full suite only.

conventions.description: Implicit areas per folder; each glob has exactly one {area}.

areas.description: Explicit areas; same name as a convention area merges with it.

depends_on.description: A depends_on B: a change in B also runs A's tests (transitive).
